verdict.rationale: Angular's documented CLI lets a user or agent drive the product's tooling through scriptable commands: creating workspaces, serving, testing, e2e, linting, updating, adding libraries, reading and writing config, deploying, and managing the cache. An llms.txt index also makes the docs machine-readable for AI use. However, the evidence shows no documented programmatic API for driving Angular beyond these command-line invocations. missing for 10: documented programmatic/library API for driving the toolchain (beyond CLI commands), API reference depth for agent use, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven use.
